=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:636-656 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In unblock_placeholder_recurrence_check, the code reuses the lookup result only when `.pr` is a number or `.reason == "ambiguous"`. In every other case it falls back to the REST listing `pulls?state=open&head=${owner}:ai/issue-${ITEM}&per_page=1`. Those cases are: routing disabled, a stop outside the lookup's list, GraphQL read_failed or parse_failed (lines 2195/2200, so UNBLOCK_IMPL_PR_RESULT_FILE is unset), `reason: unreadable` (written at 2204), and `reason: none`. When that listing comes back empty, line 650 writes `null` to hold_linked_pr.json, and heal_stale_decision reads that as "no open PR".
  WHY: An open same-repository PR that closes the heal issue from a different head branch does not show up in the branch-restricted fallback. Once HEAL_STALE_GREEN_RUNS green runs and the age gate are met, unblock_hold_close_no_recurrence closes the issue as completed while the fix PR is still open. That contradicts "any unreadable input keeps the hold" and the line 638 comment. All reviewers rated this MAJOR, mapped here to high.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:636-656 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When the #9809 lookup has already answered `{"pr": null, "reason": "none"}`, the jq test fails and the code still runs the REST `pulls?state=open&head=...ai/issue-${ITEM}` call. The GraphQL query at line 2192 already covered that check with `pullRequests(headRefName:"ai/issue-<n>", states:OPEN)`. The "no new call" / "no earlier read" comment (lines 636-641) is therefore wrong in this case.
  WHY: This costs one avoidable REST call per held placeholder_retired heal item per judge run, which goes against CLAUDE.md §14 (reuse the existing read). Behaviour stays correct. All reviewers rated this NIT, mapped here to low.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:unblock_placeholder_recurrence_check, lines 643-655 (also unblock_resolve_implementation_pr lines 2198-2204, 2195, 2200; scripts/unblock_actions.py lines 681, 688, 690) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A `{"pr": null, "reason": "unreadable"}` result, or a GraphQL read_failed / parse_failed (where the result file is never set), falls through to the REST check, which only sees `ai/issue-<n>` heads. An empty listing then writes `null` at line 650, and heal_stale_decision reads that as "no open PR".
  WHY: A trusted same-repository closing PR on a different head branch stays invisible. After 5 green runs, unblock_hold_close_no_recurrence closes the issue while that PR is open. This contradicts the changelog/README ("any unreadable input keeps the hold") and the line 638 comment. Suggested fix: omit --linked-pr-json when the reason is unreadable or the lookup failed, and use REST only when the lookup did not run.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:unblock_placeholder_recurrence_check, lines 636-638 and 647 (scripts/unblock_actions.py lines 703-711, 736) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The REST call still runs after the lookup has answered `none`, even though the GraphQL query at line 2192 already asks for `pullRequests(headRefName:"ai/issue-<n>", states:OPEN)`. The comment at lines 636-638 is no longer true.
  WHY: This adds one REST call per held placeholder_retired item per judge run, against CLAUDE.md §14. Suggested fix: decide from the result file alone (`head_branch`/`closes`/`ambiguous` → OPEN, `none` → null, `unreadable` → omit). The `open_pr_reads` assertion in test_placeholder_hold_on_heal_closes_when_failure_did_not_recur would need updating.
- TASK COMPLETENESS / INTENT GAPS: NONE. All plan-grant files are touched. The switches default to `true`. Out-of-scope items are untouched.
- HARDENING: scripts/unblock_judge.sh, unblock_resolve_implementation_pr, lines 2191-2201 (read_failed and parse_failed exits). Set a run-local flag (e.g. `UNBLOCK_IMPL_PR_LOOKUP_FAILED=true`, reset at top level) so the recurrence check omits --linked-pr-json. Estimated lines changed: 5. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
